name: Law Consolidation Final Audit
purpose: Determine whether LAW001-LAW034 can now be treated as governed family-level structures for future proof work.
audit_findings: Symbolic proliferation reduced by grouping 34 laws into 7 families.
Full traceability maintained via supersession trace registry.
All artifacts hardened with mandatory source-relation and non-separability metadata.
Counterexample and failure boundaries successfully mapped across families.
Categories reclassified to clarify mathematical and governance roles.
Human-readable overview produced with strict non-escalation guardrails.
Aggregate validation confirmed foundational pass across all consolidation sub-patches.

governance_rules.rule: Individual laws (LAW001-LAW034) remain active as members of their respective families.
